caveats: A young woman sued the City of Granger, Granger Police Department, former officer Glen Trejo, former Mayor Jose Trevino, and Lt. Juan Ceja, alleging Trejo forced her into a sexual relationship (beginning ~July 2022) and officials covered it up; filed May 17, 2024 in Yakima County Superior Court; settled for $700,000 on May 22, 2025. Yakima County prosecutor declined to file criminal charges against Trejo (insufficient evidence), though a court granted the victim a 10-year sexual assault protection order. A related tort claim by fired police chief Esteven Araguz alleging retaliation is separate from this record.
